Canada
Consular help:Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Ottawa, Canada.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Members of delegations holding official and diplomatic passports who are applying for a Canadian visa during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, and who possess an invitation letter from FIFA, are required to attach it to their online application.
In such cases, they will be exempt from providing biometric data.
If delegation members do not possess an invitation letter from FIFA, they are required to follow the standard instructions for diplomats/officials for online applications available at:
https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada/diplomatic-official-visitor-visa.html
If necessary, biometric data will be collected in person at the Visa Application Centre, and applicants will be informed in a timely manner.

Citizens of the Canada are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
